build_pp_potential: build a pseudopotential potential evaluator from atomic charges and element symbols using make_pp_potential
create_local_pseudopotential: create a local pseudopotential callable from r_grid, v_grid_loc, and ecp_mask using make_local_pseudopotential
create_nonlocal_pseudopotential: create a nonlocal pseudopotential callable from charges, r_grid, v_grid_nonloc, and ecp_mask using make_nonlocal_pseudopotential
test_vmap_sum: test the vmap_sum decorator to verify it vmapped a function and sums over the vmapped axis
review_construct_align: review the construct_align function that builds a rotation matrix to align a z axis along a given vector
